_help: Merge file. A signal with an existing id UPDATES that signal (send only the fields to change). A new id is ADDED and needs every required field. 'raw_feed' REPLACES the news list shown in the live demo. S, C, rel, abb, U are 0-100. pol: 1 supports growth, -1 warns. Allowed regions: Nordics, USA, Germany, UK, Middle East, APAC, Global. load: G, H, NG, RH, C. Optional 'name' gives a short plain-language label for charts and tables.
